name: Open the console from the front page, sign in, land in the console
description: A signed-out reader clicks the ink button Open the console, is sent to sign in, signs in with an email code, and arrives in the Eagle S replay console.

planSteps.description: Click the button Open the console (data-testid open-console)
Assert the URL path is /sign-in and the form shows a Continue with Google button and an Email address field
Type testsprite-landing-02+clerk_test@example.com into the "Email address" field and click Continue
On the verification code screen, type 424242; if a Continue button is still shown after the sixth digit, click it
Assert that within 30 seconds the URL path is /cases/eagle-s-2024 and the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown
